prerequisites: computer literacy, such as being able to use a personal computer to manage files and access the internet to download and install new software
basic notions of algebra and mathematical analysis

learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge of the basics of computer science and programming languages.
Apply the acquired knowledge in the development of simple programs.
Understand programs of simple or intermediate size.
Have autonomy and the ability to continue learning on more complex computing systems and programming environments.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to computer systems. Processes and processors. Problems, algorithms and programs. Programming languages. Computer architecture. Von Neumann model.
Fixed-base positional number systems. Base conversions. Representation of negative numbers. Representation in floating point. ASCII code. Boolean algebra.
Design algorithms with flow charts. Concept of variable. Elementary operations. Pseudo-code. Control structure if-then-else. Cycles with pre-condition.
Python programming environments. Spyder. Console. Variable Explorer. Debugging. JupyterLab. Notebook. Kernel. Cell Types: Code, Markdown, Row.

Python programming language. Declaration of variables. Type classification. Numerical and conditional expressions. Assignment statement. Compound statement. Binary selection. Standard input / output functions. Cycle statements (WHILE, FOR).
Programming with compound types. Vectors and matrices. Lists. Strings.
Programming with functions. Declaration of functions. Local variables. Formal and actual parameters. Memory usage. Life cycle of variables. Visibility of variables. Masking of variables. Recursion.

Fundamental algorithms. Calculation of execution time. Best case, worst case, and average case. Computational complexity. Sequential search. Binary search. SelectionSort. InsertionSort. BubbleSort. Mergesort. Quicksort.
Object-oriented programming. Definition of classes. Attributes and methods. Inheritance. Object-oriented design.
teaching_methods: Python programs performed on computer by students
assessment_rules: The final assessment test consists of two phases: a computer-based exam in which the student must carry out a few Python programs (20 points); and an oral exam for a final evaluation of the entire course syllabus (10 points). The final grades reflect levels of preparation from sufficient to in-depth. Weight percentages are not explicitly stated for the combined final grade.
